stem.text: A radio-controlled toy car travels along a straight line for a time of $15\,\text{s}$.
The variation with time $t$ of the velocity $v$ of the car is shown.

stem.alt: Graph of v/m s-1 against t/s, with v-axis ticks from -6.0 to 6.0 and t-axis ticks at 0, 5, 10 and 15; a step-shaped line is drawn, with a horizontal segment at 3.0 and a horizontal segment at -6.0.

stem.text: What is the average velocity of the toy car for the journey shown by the graph?
